about: Exposed continental shelf polygons for The Long Walk palaeo-shoreline layer.
source: De Groeve, J., Kusumoto, B., Koene, E. et al. (2022). Global raster dataset on historical coastline positions and shelf sea extents since the Last Glacial Maximum. Global Ecology and Biogeography 31(11): 2162-2171. https://doi.org/10.1111/geb.13573
data: Historic coastline age raster (AGE 2021), Figshare https://doi.org/10.21942/uva.c.5754779.v1
changes: Changes were made: the coastline-age raster was thresholded at 19,000, 12,900 and 9,550 years ago at full resolution (2 arc-minutes) within five regional boxes, converted to polygons, simplified at 0.05 degrees, rounded to 2 decimal places, and pieces smaller than 0.003 square degrees removed. Each region shows only the shelf inside its box; where the shelf continues past the box edge, the fill is cut there and no coastline is drawn along the cut.
kept_percent_note: Share of the full-resolution exposed shelf inside each region box that survives simplification and the size cut.
